{{Top|leg}}
A '''Training Center''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] facility were new recruits were sent after passing the entry requirements and screening from local [[Imperial Recruitment Office]]s. Recruits sent to Training Centers were subject to medical examinations and intellectual assessment. Retina scans were registered and matched against Imperial records.
